reason: Conversation 1 guided the user through the full sequence: emptying the bin, checking the wand, then washing the filter and drying it. It also gave useful maintenance advice (wash the filter regularly, empty the bin more often), and it correctly treated the pulsing as airflow protection. It has flaws: it kept saying 'unplug', repeated itself, suggested a radiator and then warned against it, and it missed the filter being the second cause. Conversation 2 resolved the blockage quickly and avoided unsupported claims, but it mentioned a failing battery, never asked about the filter, never told the user to wash it, and closed without advice, even though the filter had never been washed in 3 years and was a contributing cause. That left the underlying problem unaddressed and the pulsing likely to return.
